messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS 2.0.3 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,


rNOMADS 2.0.3 is available on CRAN as of yesterday morning.  I went through the list of real time models and had to make a few modifications based on changes on the NOMADS server.  I also added the High Resolution Rapid Refresh model, a recent addition to NOMADS that runs in 15 minute increments with a grid spacing of ~3 km across North America.


In other news, you can now give DODSGrab multiple variables; previously you could only give it one.


Best,


Danny


Daniel C. Bowman
Doctoral Candidate in Geophysics
Mitchell 315
Department of Geological Sciences
The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] new rNOMADS release fixes critical bug in BuildProfile()
messages.subject_clean: [Rnomads-user] new rNOMADS release fixes critical bug in BuildProfile()
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,


Someone pointed out some unexpected behavior in the BuildProfile() function.  The function was not returning values for the correct area.  I fixed the bug and put a new version of rNOMADS on CRAN.  I expect it will be available in the next 24-48 hours.  I strongly encourage you to update rNOMADS at that time.

Thanks, and sorry for the inconvenience,


Danny
